name: Ballet agent
description: Makes this devcontainer an agent pool for Ballet: installs the Ballet agent, Claude Code and an unprivileged session user (ADR-0025).

pool.description: Pool label of the agents: the project's execution setting 'pool' sends its runs here. Empty: no pool.

sessionUser.description: OS user sessions run as (created if missing). Empty: sessions run as the agent's user (root).

agentUrl.description: URL of the agent binary, ${ARCH} replaced by amd64 or arm64, when the Feature does not bundle it (make feature).

installClaude.description: Install Claude Code for every user unless it is installed already.
